meta.name: firebase-hosting-basics
meta.description: Deploys and configures classic Firebase Hosting for static websites, single-page apps (SPAs), and microservices. Use when deploying static sites/SPAs, setting up custom domains, configuring firebase.json hosting settings (redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site), or managing preview channels. Don't use for Firebase App Hosting (Next.js/SSR), Auth, Firestore queries/rules, Data Connect, or Crashlytics.

copy.tagline: 将静态网站和单页应用部署到 Firebase Hosting,并配置域名与托管规则
copy.tagline_en: Deploy static sites/SPAs to Firebase Hosting, set up domains and redirects.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you deploy static sites to Firebase Hosting and need domain/redirect config.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 帮你部署和配置经典版 Firebase Hosting,支持静态网站、单页应用(SPA)和微服务。能设置自定义域名、修改 firebase.json 中的重定向/重写/请求头/多站点配置,并管理预览频道;不处理 Firebase App Hosting、Auth 等。
howto.when: 当你想部署静态网站或 SPA、设置自定义域名或管理预览频道等时触发;不适用于认证、App Hosting 等场景。

say.text: 创建一个新的预览频道,方便我预览改动。

howto.what_en: Enables deploying/configuring classic Firebase Hosting for static sites, SPAs, microservices. Covers custom domains, firebase.json settings (redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site), preview channels. Excludes App Hosting, Auth, Firestore, Data Connect, Crashlytics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy a static site/SPA, set up a custom domain, or manage preview channels. Not for App Hosting, Auth, Firestore, Data Connect, Crashlytics.

say_en.text: Deploy this static site to Firebase.
